name: YuXin Kylin 3x3 V2
description: The YuXin Kylin 3x3 V2 is the latest evolution of the renowned Kylin series, engineered for speedcubers who demand fault-tolerant performance and precision. This second iteration retains the iconic 55mm size and lightweight 72g build, making it perfect for fast and controlled solves.
features: High-performance, forgiving turning with outstanding corner cutting
Durable frosted plastic surface for improved feel and grip
Advanced anti-sticking groove design for smooth, lock-up-free solves
Customizable with adjustable elasticity and a lightened central axis
